title: Combinatorics of the Cosmohedron
summary: The cosmohedron was recently proposed as a polytope underlying the cosmological wavefunction for $\text{Tr}(Φ^3)$ theory. Its faces were conjectured to be in bijection with Matryoshkas, which are obtained from a subdivision of a polygon by sequentially wrapping groups of polygons into larger polygons. In this paper we prove the correctness of this construction, and elucidate its combinatorial structure.
